defaults.cohort: ISS astronauts, Increments 26S–50S (April 2011 – September 2017); N = 46 overall
defaults.countermeasure: ISS, ARED era (2011–2017): ARED, T2 treadmill and CEVIS cycle; about 600 min/week of aerobic and resistance exercise

mission_duration.wording: Forty-six astronauts (37 males, 9 females; ... [mean ± SD]) were assigned to missions of 178 ± 48 d.

defaults.baseline_timepoint: Preflight (60–90 days before flight for strength tests; about L-90 for DXA)
defaults.notes: Fig. 2 prints 'effect size (a, b)' for each endpoint and its caption calls the bracket a 95% CI. The effect size does not lie inside its bracket, and the bracket matches the percent changes given in the text for three endpoints (VO2peak −7.4% ± 2.0%; BMD −2.1% ± 0.7% and −3.7% ± 0.6%, PDF page 2), so the bracket is read here as the 95% CI of the mean percent change. The CI bounds are reported; the central value is an approximation (the CI midpoint, which assumes a symmetric interval) and agrees with the markers drawn in Fig. 1. To replace it: the per-endpoint means in Supplemental Tables 3–6, which are not in the local PDF.
